facts.value: Starts scanning at the address of lbCommand_803B9840, not at a pointer loaded from its first element. The scan end is OSGetConsoleSimulatedMemSize() + 0x80000000. Pointer candidates use the physical ceiling returned by OSGetPhysicalMemSize and the lower bound ((u32)scan + 32) & 0x0FFFFFE0. A candidate with validated header and registration backlink sets bit 0 in its table entry. The table pass clears marked entries, skips null and table-internal pointers, reports each remaining entry, and returns the count.
